The main pushback is defense (oaa) (~-0.6pp): TB defense grades +24 OAA better on the season — a run-prevention headwind. The price has held roughly steady since posting — the current +147 still sits inside the playable range (to +137). The edge is the model pricing OAK differently than the market rather than one of the marquee starter/lineup/bullpen buckets — worth taking at the number, not chasing past it.
